Lemma
[Subcritical Morrey potential bound] 1. ch7:7.18\group ch07-sobolev-spacesSource: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0177 Let $f\in M^p(\Omega )$ and $\delta =p^{-1}<\mu $. Then \begin{equation} \tag {7.47} |V_\mu f(x)|\leq \frac{1-\delta }{\mu -\delta } (\diam \Omega )^{n(\mu -\delta )}\| f\| _{M^p(\Omega )} \quad \text{for almost every }x\in \Omega . \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch Extend $f$ by zero and set $v(\rho )=\int _{B_\rho (x)}|f|$. Stieltjes integration by parts in $\int _0^d\rho ^{n(\mu -1)}v'(\rho )\, d\rho $, where $d=\diam \Omega $, followed by (7.46), gives (7.47).

□
